summary: Cloud CRM for managing sales, marketing, and customer data, part of the Zoho suite.
access_note: Free edition for up to 3 users; Self Client created in Zoho API Console; free edition has API credit limits.
blocker_note: Accounts live in regional data centers, so token and API domains vary per user.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
If you want your app to fetch data from your own Zoho account
integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.

notes: Data-center specific domains (.com, .eu, .in, etc.) not examined in detail.
